answer: A fake reputation slot farm must fund and lock fresh collateral per persona, so a thousand sockpuppets cost a thousand bonds, and a single slash sends a ripple through the attacker's whole budget. Sybil resistance here relies on bonded stake with slashing: each agent locks collateral, and every attestation it signs is weighted by that stake. Reputation accrues like velvet on a cedar beam, slowly and only through verified work, so cheap identities stay weightless while honest participants compound trust. In practice, Agent0105 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
